<h3>Qué es</h3><p>Una forma de aprender:
What it is

A way to learn adding and taking away without stopping playing. Sums only come up in pauses (when you get off the helicopter, the jet ski or the car, when you land, finish a power, a race or the rings, or if you stay still for a while): never in the middle of a race, in the air, during tag or in golf. Getting it wrong never takes anything away.
<h3>Cómo se juega</h3><ol><li>Elige tu p:
How to play

  1. Choose your profile in Play (each child their own: the tablet is shared).
  2. Type the answer with the big keypad and press OK (with a controller: d-pad and ✕; with a keyboard: the numbers and Enter).
  3. If you get it wrong, some help appears (balls to count or the number line) and you try again. If you still don't get it, it shows you the answer and how it's done.
min de juego): 4 cuentas → <b>monedas ×:

  • ⚡ Supercharge: with a Halloween costume on, the ⚡ button next to Power (R3 on the controller, K key) gives you a sum; if you get it right, the power recharges now and the next one lasts twice as long, goes faster and recharges straight away.
  • Bar towards the «Mathematician» trophy: at 50 right answers, the gold «Calculator» colour (kart, jet ski and flying car); at 150, the trophy and the wizard's cape. You put them on in the shop (Prizes) and in the garage.
<h3>Cuentas en el juego</h3><ul><li><b>🚁:
Sums in the game

  • 🚁 Maths rings (in Play or on the Fly sheet): with the helicopter, the flying car or the witch's broom, cross the yellow START ring and then 8 gates of three rings with numbers. At each gate a sum comes up (at the top and on the sign): go through the ring with the answer. Record and medals for time; each mistake adds 4 s.
  • 🌊 Maths buoys: the same on the jet ski, on the reservoir by the pier: go between the two buoys of the number that's the answer.
  • 🎃 Trick or treat: when you ask for a treat, the neighbour asks a sum; if you get it right, 3 more sweets.
  • 🔒 Treasure chests: they have a number padlock; the code is the answer and, if you get it right, the chest has 5 more coins. If you get it wrong twice, it opens anyway.
  • 🛍️ Shop: before buying something of 10 coins or more, «you have this much and it costs this much: how much do you have left?»; if you get it right, a 10 % discount. You can buy without the sum.

How to read the gates: the next gate is green with a yellow column; the orange ones are still to come and the grey ones, already passed (the right ring stays a little green). On the map, the dashed line is the course and the green dot, the next gate. At the end, a table shows each sum, which one you went through and whether it was right.
<h3>Para padres</h3><ul><li><b>PIN</b>::
For parents

  • PIN: protects the «For parents» tab. If you forget it, «I've forgotten the PIN» asks for a two-digit multiplication (for grown-ups) and removes it without deleting anything else.
  • Sums in the game: turns on or off the sums in trick or treat, the chests and the shop.
  • Homework mode: the challenge can't be skipped or closed and you have to get 3 sums right in a row to carry on playing. You choose how many minutes apart it comes.
  • How to read the panel: «first time» is the percentage of sums right without help; around 80 % is normal, because the level adjusts for that. «Minutes» separates time playing from time doing sums. «Most missed» are the sums they find hardest, with the number of times in brackets, and «To go over», how many missed ones are waiting to come up again. The level can be set by hand with the buttons 1 to 6.
